summary: A new fixed-cost pre-work public-byte/address predicate passed 23 exact authored local cases. A separate local bounded-material draft now calls it before any yield or search while retaining the later full assembly key check. That producer integration remains unexecuted and unpublished; this result does not qualify nonce search, actual preparation, SDK, runtime pricing, payment, signing, provider operation or a pilot.

basis.roadmap: P1-A explicit DP resource budget and selected payer preparation boundary; unsigned, opt-in and default-off.
basis.sourceFinding: The retained local material producer checked key syntax but deferred payer/public-byte agreement to assembly after candidate work. The new predicate permits that cheap refusal before candidate work; the independent final key/hash/work/price checks are not removed.
basis.normativeRule: Existing post-work key binding rule: go-zenon e58d8e80eabd9fd5630ed62e0707424d96b5303c common/types/address.go, zero user-address prefix plus the first 19 bytes of SHA3-256(publicKey32).
basis.inputContract: One unchanged exact unsigned AccountBlock DATA grammar, with a present canonical 32-byte Base64 public key, zero hash/nonce and empty signature.

implementation.output: Frozen 21-field public-byte/address consistency DATA receipt; no AccountBlock, nonce, payment, payload, authority or operational method.
implementation.cost: One fixed 32-byte public-key SHA3-256 digest plus bounded existing field/address validation; no candidate search.
implementation.positiveDifficultyTreatment: Accepted only as pre-work declared DATA; no nonce predicate is evaluated.

argvShape: X402_DP_PRE_WORK_KEY_SOURCE_PINS=<exact18 private file and identity pins>

qualifiedBehavior: Validate actual pre-work block address against canonical supplied public bytes through the retained closed field snapshot and address codec.
Return exactly 21 frozen primitive DATA fields; expose no prepared block or work/sign/publication capability.
Reject canonical but mismatched keys and foreign user/non-user addresses without repairing the payer.
Reject empty/noncanonical/incorrect-sized public keys, signed/already-hashed/nonzero-nonce inputs, malformed fields, surplus authority fields and unsupported object mechanics.
Reject getters, proxies and coercion hooks without invoking them; preserve mutable caller records and retain detached receipt bindings.
Keep positive declared difficulty explicitly unperformed, and preserve key-possession/signature/funding/chain/authority non-claims.
Retain the unchanged legacy full hash/zero-work/key consumer as a distinct later stage; the pre-work predicate cannot replace it.
qualification.notQualified: Bounded-material producer admission/search/read ordering and full DP preparation integration were not imported or executed by this selection.

scope: Capture this pre-work validator in the existing bounded material exchange and call it on a private detached block with the configured public key before the initial yield and captured SEARCH.
Retain original work-request evidence flags, original block/quote, one-use/busy/used guards, bounded search limits and the independent full assembly key check.
Update only the unexecuted material and bounded-balance draft cases for early mismatch refusal; preserve all earlier source-pinned qualification entries.
localIntegrationDraft.earlyKeyMismatchSavings: Source ordering would avoid bounded candidate work and later assembly/read cycles for a mismatched key; the producer-level observation still requires its separately admitted qualification.

nonClaims: The predicate proves declared public-byte/address consistency, not a valid curve point, key possession, wallet/payer authority, signature or chain truth.
The same key/address with coherent changed transfer DATA does not establish selected external payment intent or grant authority.
No nonce candidate, PoW producer, actual SDK preparation, actual chain PREPARE, real signature, payment, publication, provider READY, service delivery or pilot acceptance was exercised.
The standalone 23-case result does not qualify the unexecuted producer linkage or the proposed 277-case composed selection.
Parse-only success is not import, behavior, work execution, lifetime/cancellation or native-cleanup proof.
Price policy/runtime p, current account/funding, payer/provider/policy authority, same-signed-payment uncertainty, persistence and process restart remain independent acceptance gates.
Original request/payment bytes, exact hash/payload/requirements/context, consumed authority and VALIDATED possible exact-same-signed-block resend versus UNKNOWN/ACKNOWLEDGED remain unchanged.
